correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and q=(1-epsilon)^2 in (0,1), stationary covariance equations are a contraction and reduce by symmetry to a cyclic two-step discounted Green function. Its Fourier trace gives explicit H_n. The inequalities t<1/6, H_n>H_{n+1} and F_q strictly increasing prove the infinite order without enumeration; the stated asymptotic gap follows by a mean-value theorem. A package-local standalone exact-rational full-pair checker confirms the formula for 24 instances, with 339 total finite and high-precision assertions. Finite tests are supporting evidence only.

value.rationale: The exact one-lag size-identification result closes an explicitly motivated local-to-global inference gap for the nontrivial infinite family of hub-rooted wheels, all rim sizes n>=3 and all fixed noise 0<epsilon<1. Fourier Green-function analysis resolves parity, gives a positive limiting correlation, and proves an inverse-square adjacent-size separation relevant to asymptotic identifiability. No arbitrary unmotivated finite slice or simple reparameterization is used; finite testing supplements a general proof.
